subject: Ronaldinho legend
title: Ronaldinho scored all 23 goals at 13

lines.vo: At thirteen, he scored all twenty-three goals in a twenty-three-nil win.
His team-mates came for the oranges.
At eight, he was the smallest boy on the pitch. They called him Ronaldinho: little Ronaldo.
Two thousand and two, World Cup, Brazil against England. A forty-yard free-kick curls past David Seaman.
Seven minutes later: sent off. Genius, then a red card. Relatable.
Two thousand and five: Ballon d'Or. Real Madrid's own fans stood and applauded him at the Bernabéu. Voluntarily.
The first Barcelona player to get that since Maradona. Smallest boy on the pitch. Biggest name in the stadium.
Your mates will never guess this. Match news and betting tips at aboutfootball dot UK.
